Connection.Name: Destination
Connection.Label: Configure Connection
Connection.Hint: Set the Sending Stone app events are posted to and the shared secret it expects, and test the connection.

Campaigns.Name: Campaigns
Campaigns.Label: Manage Campaigns
Campaigns.Hint: Group player characters into campaigns, each with its own title. Events involving a campaign's characters are sent to that campaign, described for it alone.

ChatEvents.Name: Send Chat Events
ChatEvents.Hint: Post chat messages as they are created, edited and deleted.

ChatScope.Name: Chat Messages to Send
ChatScope.Hint: Send each campaign every chat message its players can read, or only those spoken by one of its characters.

CombatEvents.Name: Send Combat Events
CombatEvents.Hint: Post combat tracker changes: encounters starting and ending, turns and rounds, and combatants joining, leaving, rolling initiative and being defeated.

GmContent.Name: Send Gamemaster-Only Information
GmContent.Hint: Also send what only a Gamemaster can see: whispers no player can read, blind rolls, hidden combatants, the hit points of combatants outside a campaign and the armor class of attack targets. Leave this off if players can see what the destination receives.

Connection.Title: Sending Stone: Connection
Connection.Hint: Events are posted as JSON, one per request, from the active Gamemaster's browser. Nothing is sent while no Gamemaster is connected.
Connection.DestinationHint: The address of the Sending Stone app, such as https://sending-stone.vercel.app. Only the host is needed; the path events go to is added for you. The app must allow cross-origin requests from this Foundry server.
Connection.EndpointNone: Enter a destination to see where events are posted.
Connection.SecretHint: The secret you gave your campaigns in the Sending Stone app; one secret serves every campaign in this world. Sent as a bearer token in the Authorization header. Stored only in this browser, so players cannot read it; enter it in each browser a Gamemaster runs the game from.
Connection.BridgeNone: No Gamemaster is connected, so nothing is being sent
Connection.TestOk: Delivered: the destination answered HTTP {status} in {elapsed} ms.
Connection.HintNetwork: Check that the destination is running and reachable from this computer, and that it answers the browser's CORS preflight (OPTIONS) request with Access-Control-Allow-Origin, and Access-Control-Allow-Headers covering Content-Type and Authorization.
Connection.HintMixedContent: Foundry is served over https but the destination is plain http, which browsers block for any host other than localhost. Serve the destination over https.
Connection.HintAuth: The destination rejected the request. Check the shared secret.
Connection.HintNotSetUp: The destination has no campaign set up for this game. Set up each campaign in the Sending Stone app, with this game's address and the same secret, then test again.

Campaigns.Title: Sending Stone: Campaigns
Campaigns.Hint: Each campaign gets the events that involve its characters: messages their players can read or they spoke, and combats they are in. Set up each campaign in the Sending Stone app with the same title, so give each a different one. A character can be in more than one campaign.
Campaigns.NoCharacters: There are no player characters in this world.
Campaigns.None: No campaigns yet. Add one, then tick the characters in it.
Campaigns.TitleTaken: Each campaign needs a different title.

Error.InvalidDestination: The destination must be a web address, such as https://sending-stone.vercel.app.
Error.Network: the destination could not be reached
Error.Timeout: the destination did not answer in time

Notify.Failing: Sending Stone cannot deliver events to the destination: {error}. Events are being dropped until it recovers.
Notify.Recovered: Sending Stone is delivering events to the destination again.
